nodes.label: Single Go Binary Deployment — Embedded SPA + REST API
nodes.rationale: Simplifies deployment to a single binary serving both the Go REST API and embedded React SPA, reducing operational complexity for self-hosted users.
nodes.norm_label: single go binary deployment — embedded spa + rest api

nodes.label: Dockerfile Multi-Stage Build — node:22 → golang:1.23 → distroless
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage build produces a ~3MB distroless final image; node stage builds the SPA, Go stage embeds it and compiles the binary, distroless runtime has no shell attack surface.
nodes.norm_label: dockerfile multi-stage build — node:22 → golang:1.23 → distroless

nodes.label: FIFO Cost Basis Algorithm — computeFIFOPositions
nodes.rationale: FIFO computed in Go (not SQL) to handle BONUS/SPLIT adjustments and partial-lot consumption with float tolerance. Diverges from avg-cost snapshots intentionally.

nodes.label: Avg-Cost Snapshot Formula — computeForDate Divergence
nodes.rationale: Snapshot service uses simpler avg-cost SQL (not FIFO) for historical trend snapshots, trading accuracy for query simplicity and matching typical AMC statement conventions.

nodes.label: Deterministic Signal Actions — scoreToAction Matrix
nodes.rationale: Actions computed deterministically from Go score logic BEFORE LLM call; AI is only permitted to write the prose justification. Action overwritten server-side after AI responds.

nodes.label: Market Mood Percentile Algorithm — P/E vs 3Y Distribution
nodes.norm_label: market mood percentile algorithm — p/e vs 3y distribution

nodes.label: TimescaleDB Hypertables — prices, portfolio_snapshots, market_data
nodes.rationale: Hypertables enable cheap range queries (chunk pruning), per-chunk compression (10x+ space savings), and continuous aggregates for Trends page — essential for time-series price and snapshot data.

nodes.label: LATERAL JOIN Pattern — Latest Price Per Instrument
nodes.norm_label: lateral join pattern — latest price per instrument

nodes.label: No ORM/sqlc — Raw pgx Queries Inline
nodes.rationale: Schema is small (~20 tables) and queries are hand-tuned for Timescale chunk pruning. Teaching sqlc about Timescale LATERAL/time_bucket/last() would exceed the benefit.
nodes.norm_label: no orm/sqlc — raw pgx queries inline
